text:
Predicates:
FliesTo(x, y) ::: x flies to y.
FliesFrom(x, y) ::: x flies from y.
Premises:
FliesTo(susan, lga) ::: Susan flies to LGA airport.
∀x ∀y (FliesTo(x, y) → ¬FliesFrom(x, y)) ::: The departure and arrival can not be the same airport.
FliesFrom(john, lga) ::: John flies from LGA airport.
Conclusion:
FliesFrom(susan, lga) ::: Susan flies from LGA airport.
